detail_text: It is the Government’s belief that only the OEM, ADRICK MARINE CORPORATION , CAGE CODE 5V854 , or their authorized distributors , can obtain the required technical and engineering data and genuine OEM parts required to successfully provide these items. Authorized distributors who have business concerns and the required capabilities to provide these items are invited to submit a quote. If you submit a quote for this solicitation, IT MUST include a letter from the OEM, ADRICK MARINE CORPORATION ., CAGE CODE 5V854 , verifying your company is an authorized distributor. The United States Coast Guard Surface Forces Logistics Center has a requirement for the following items: NO SUBSTITUTIONS WILL BE AUTHORIZED WITHOUT APPROVAL FROM USCG SFLC TECHNICAL EXPERTS.
